title: GOOD: IpfsLatencyMonitor uses Release/Acquire ordering for backpressure state transition
description: backpressure.rs: active flag stores with Ordering::Release and loads with Ordering::Acquire. The comment explicitly explains the happens-before edge: any thread that reads active==true via Acquire is guaranteed to observe the ema_ms_bits value that caused the transition. Downgrading to Relaxed would be wrong because a Relaxed store could become visible before the ema_ms_bits update, breaking diagnostics that read ema_ms() after observing backpressure_active()==true. The ordering choice is correct and the comment prevents future 'optimization' that would introduce a subtle race.
